title: Money growing continuously in a bank
body: Meera deposits Rs 5000 in a bank scheme in which the principal increases continuously at the rate of 8% per year. If P (in rupees) is the principal at time t (in years), the rate at which the principal grows at any instant is proportional to the principal at that instant, so dP/dt = (8/100) P = 0.08P, with P = 5000 when t = 0. This is a first order, first degree differential equation of the variables separable type. Meera wants to know how long her money will take to reach certain amounts. Use log 2 = 0.6931, where log denotes the natural logarithm.
